scope: Read-only scene/config/Genesis/pyuipc source audit; no GPU simulation launched by reviewer in this phase.

resolved_findings.issue: IPC shell thickness is a one-sided radius, while Genesis docstring labels thickness generically
resolved_findings.resolution: Use radius 0.0004m for full 0.0008m shell; validator uses rest area * rho * 2r.

resolved_findings.issue: Changing desc.init_qpos alters the neutral FK reference qpos0 instead of actual initial robot pose
resolved_findings.resolution: initialize_before_ipc sets actual q after rigid solver build and forward-kinematics before IPC geometry build, preserving qpos0.

resolved_findings.issue: Same E for shell stretch/shear yields thickness-independent excessively high shear stiffness
resolved_findings.resolution: configure_shell_shear changes only this scene native triangle mu to explicitly selected effective shear stiffness 20 N/m; uncalibrated.

resolved_findings.issue: FEM velocity returned by Genesis remains stale with IPC
resolved_findings.resolution: Saved-state audit uses actual position/joint differences rather than get_state().vel.

remaining_limits: Two-way soft constraint uses separate affine contact bodies and allows geometric discrepancy; log coupling_diagnostics each captured frame.
IPC CCD/sanity enabled improves contact handling but does not prove whole sequence successful; fail-closed gates and independent audit remain necessary.
Homogeneous plush is a compressible elastic effective material; shell is effective isotropic cloth, not separate fabric skin/filling or measured orthotropic weave.
Robot rigid-rigid contacts are handled by Genesis while IPC handles cloth/body/robot and cloth/body self contact.
No frame-sampling method proves continuous nonpenetration; full output includes explicit limits.
Final bag consists of exactly two curved cloth panels with shared U seam, no bottom or side panels; topology audit passed without changing the approved shape.

performance_observation.inference: IPC CUDA work dominates; switching Genesis CPU to CUDA alone is unlikely to remove the main cost. No Newton iteration breakdown was recorded because timers were disabled.

recommended_profiling: After scene.build, enable uipc.Timer.enable_all(); after 20-40 steps save uipc.Timer.report_as_json().
independent_validator: validate.py: actual mouth topology, virtual cap containment, mass, table clearance, tet orientation, cloth stretch, every-step actual joint rates, task event order and post-handoff pose.
selected_material_config: config_two_panel_coarse.json; bag full thickness 0.0006m, E=400000Pa, density=500kg/m3, bending=5e-6Nm, independent shear=5N/m; all are uncalibrated estimates.

critical_new_findings.issue: Genesis two-way feedback omits native ABD COM translation-rotation term and uses MJCF rather than IPC mass moments
critical_new_findings.evidence: At t=.05s left fingers original feedback opening-axis components -2.156/-1.996N; exact STC translation gradients +33.278/+33.264N. Native mass .0313438kg vs MJCF .015kg.
critical_new_findings.resolution: Opt-in scene-local physics_config.install_exact_stc_feedback uses exact STC Gp/GA and rigid-target virtual-work pullback. CPU gradient verification passed; integrated physics validation pending.

critical_new_findings.issue: Apparent teddy lift in grasp03 is invalid because tetrahedra invert
critical_new_findings.evidence: grasp03 min volume ratio -1.295, maximum 1.21% reference volume inverted; full task and grasp physics fail.
critical_new_findings.resolution: Finite jaw opening, finite-force control, explicit J>.05 gate, improved tetrahedral quality, and corrected feedback under validation.

critical_new_findings.issue: Curved handles stretch mainly through model-axis shear and transverse collapse
critical_new_findings.evidence: open01 handle length1.215, transverse minimum.731, worst-edge adjacent triangle area.925, model I5 only1.0106/1.0176 and I6.4495.
critical_new_findings.resolution: Increase independent shear alongside extension stiffness; keep bending separate. Do not loosen the 15% edge stretch audit.

contact_targeting: contact_grasp.py: incident-triangle surface normals, clipped pad footprint, minimum initial opening, material-point observers without physical attachment.
independent_deformation_report: validate.bear_deformation_audit reports first inversion, worst tet location/reference quality, stage volume ratios and weighted stretch statistics.
